d: From haunted locations and creepy places to unexplained events and strange phenomena, the world is full of mysteries waiting to be investigated. In Expedition X, Josh Gates brings together investigators to explore paranormal activity, conduct ghost investigations and examine reports of supernatural encounters. This Expedition X Documentary follows the team as they visit scary locations, uncover dark history and search for paranormal evidence, EVP evidence and ghost evidence. From ghost hunting and haunted house investigations to unexplained mysteries and mysterious places, every case…
